screen.xporbtrails.missing_trail_png: The selected PNG is missing. The default trail is currently shown.
screen.xporbtrails.trail_type.tip: Choose the default trail, spaced stamps, a continuous ribbon, or copies of the current orb.
screen.xporbtrails.png_colors: PNG artwork uses its original colors.
screen.xporbtrails.pickup_png_timing: PNG artwork uses its original colors and the timing of its frames.
screen.xporbtrails.no_trail_png: Add PNG artwork under config/xp_orb_trails/trail/sprites, then reload files on the Profiles page.
screen.xporbtrails.afterimage_source.tip: Afterimages capture the orb body. Emitted particles move independently. Click to edit the orb.
screen.xporbtrails.title: XP Orb Trail Settings
screen.xporbtrails.show_vanilla_orb.tip: Show the original orb beneath its artwork. Turn this off to display only the selected artwork.
screen.xporbtrails.orb_scale.tip: Scale the orb's custom artwork. 1.00 is its original size.
screen.xporbtrails.flight_effect.tip: Choose moving orb artwork from orb/sprites or orb/effects. Replacement sprite sheets repeat while the vanilla orb is hidden.
screen.xporbtrails.flight_pulse.tip: Sends a band of light along the trail while the orb moves.
screen.xporbtrails.file_styles.tip: Edit or add JSON files in config/xp_orb_trails/profiles. Click a profile to apply its appearance.
screen.xporbtrails.reload_styles.tip: Reload defaults, profiles and artwork. See latest.log for file errors.
screen.xporbtrails.enabled.tip: Enable orb artwork, trails and pickup effects. Turning this off restores the vanilla orb.
screen.xporbtrails.glow.tip: Uses brighter additive blending; disable it for softer colors.
screen.xporbtrails.color_mode.tip: Choose a solid color, two-color gradient, or animated rainbow.
screen.xporbtrails.save_preset.tip: Save the current colors and gradient stops. You can store up to 12 palettes.
screen.xporbtrails.width.tip: Adjust the width of the default trail or a continuous ribbon.
screen.xporbtrails.rainbow_speed.tip: Controls how quickly rainbow colors cycle over time.
screen.xporbtrails.lifetime.tip: How long points remain; higher values produce longer trails.
screen.xporbtrails.pickup_fade.tip: Time taken for the remaining trail to fade after its orb disappears, including collection. Independent of the pickup flash.
screen.xporbtrails.smoothness.tip: Smoothly flows older trail points toward the orb.
screen.xporbtrails.motion_shift.tip: Moves the trail anchor backward when an orb travels quickly.
screen.xporbtrails.camera_push.tip: Moves the trail slightly away from the camera to reduce overlap with the orb.
screen.xporbtrails.tail_width.tip: Width farthest from the orb; zero creates a pointed tail.
screen.xporbtrails.middle_width.tip: Adjusts the center of the trail with smooth transitions to both ends.
screen.xporbtrails.pickup_flash.tip: Plays an effect when an XP orb is collected.
screen.xporbtrails.pickup_flash_strength: Adjusts the brightness and visibility of the pickup flash.
screen.xporbtrails.pickup_flash_duration: Controls how long the pickup animation plays.
screen.xporbtrails.pickup_flash_size.tip: Controls flash size independently of trail width.
screen.xporbtrails.flash_style.tip: Choose an animation from pickup/effects or pickup/sprites to play when an orb is collected.
screen.xporbtrails.save_profile.tip: Saves settings from every page, up to 8 complete custom profiles.
screen.xporbtrails.overwrite_profile.tip: Overwrites the selected custom profile with all current settings while keeping its name.
screen.xporbtrails.rename_profile.tip: Changes the selected custom profile's name.
screen.xporbtrails.range.tip: Trails beyond this distance are not rendered.
screen.xporbtrails.cap.tip: Maximum simultaneous trails; lower this for extreme performance cases.
screen.xporbtrails.colors.tip: The default trail and file effects using trail colors share this palette. PNG artwork keeps its own colors.
screen.xporbtrails.trail_sprite.body_hid: Show the vanilla orb or choose orb artwork
screen.xporbtrails.trail_sprite.tip: Choose artwork from config/xp_orb_trails/trail/sprites. PNGs keep their original colors.
screen.xporbtrails.trail_sprite_mode.tip: Place separate copies along the path or wrap the image along a continuous ribbon.
screen.xporbtrails.fixed_stamps.tip: Leave each stamp where the orb passed. Its animation starts at that point and it fades in place.
screen.xporbtrails.ribbon_mapping.tip: Map one image along the trail by distance or by segment, or lock its pattern as the trail moves.
Distance in blocks for one copy of the repeating pattern.
screen.xporbtrails.ribbon_caps.tip: The sheet defines both end caps and how the middle is drawn.
screen.xporbtrails.stamp_spacing.tip: Space stamps farther apart at higher values. 1.00 targets 0.2 blocks between stamps.
screen.xporbtrails.stamp_scale.tip: Resize each stamp independently of spacing. 1.00 is its default size.
screen.xporbtrails.effect_strength.tip: Adjust the overall strength of orb artwork, trails and pickup effects.
screen.xporbtrails.custom_shape.tip: Fine-tune the tail, middle, and head proportions.
screen.xporbtrails.cross_section.tip: 2: a flat ribbon facing the camera. 3–31: polygonal tube. 32: round approximation. More sides cost more geometry; 8 is a good starting point. View the 3D shape in-world.
Use the outline from your JSON file along the trail. Turn this off to choose 2–32 sides and back on to restore your outline.
This outline uses %s radii. Turn off the custom cross-section to choose a built-in side count.
screen.xporbtrails.saved_colors.tip: Apply a saved pair by clicking its name, or manage it. Up to 12 pairs.
screen.xporbtrails.profile_name.tip: Enter a name, then press Rename.
screen.xporbtrails.start_color.tip: Choose the solid color or the tail end of the gradient.
screen.xporbtrails.end_color.tip: Choose the gradient color nearest the orb.
screen.xporbtrails.color_name.tip: Enter a name, then press Rename.
screen.xporbtrails.pickup.tip: Adjust flash strength, size, and duration.
screen.xporbtrails.apply_color.tip: Apply this color pair. Switches rainbow mode to gradient.
